why: RJ-P12 (photo/tone-controls PT-4), pending TC-6 (suiteui/tone-controls, #4953): named .jobs.pending.json so the harness skips it, since tone.set's run throws notBuilt until TC-6 builds ToneCommands' bodies, and the folder has no input yet (the harness needs one). It is renamed to white-balance.jobs.json when TC-6 lands, with input/tungsten-grey.png (a grey card shot under 3200 K light, so it reads orange) and expected/tungsten-grey-balanced.png. The job: tone.set temperature -30 and tint 5 on the image, then a PNG export. The trap: white balance works only on the whole image, not on an adjustment layer. The assertion: the grey card's mean reads neutral in the export (|R - B| <= 3/255).
